data.headline: Nasdaq flags late filing as AREC’s mine permits remain pre-production

claims.text: AREC received a Nasdaq notice for failing to timely file its June Form 10-Q.

citation.quote: On August 20, 2026, American Resources Corporation (the “Company”) received a letter from The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) notifying the Company that it is not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to the Company’s failure to timely file its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026

claims.text: The notice had no immediate effect on the listing or trading of AREC’s common stock.

citation.quote: The notification has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the Company’s common stock on The Nasdaq Capital Market.

claims.text: AREC must submit an amended plan by September 4, 2026, while the maximum potential extension runs to October 15, 2026.

citation.quote: The Company is required to amend its original plan to address the March Form10-Q filing delinquency to now address the June Form 10-Q filing delinquency and submit such amendment to Nasdaq no later than September 4, 2026.

claims.text: The company’s disclosed mining portfolio remains pre-production in Wyoming County Coal, with permits in planning and no mines currently producing.

citation.quote: The mining permits held by Wyoming County Coal are in various stages of planning with no mines currently in production.

claims.text: Perry County Resources’ two idled underground permits are being maintained pending coal-market changes that could warrant restarting production.

citation.quote: The two idled mining permits are for underground mines and have been actively mined in the past and being maintained as idled, pending any changes to the coal market that may warrant re-starting production.
